posts.text: [Image] The image features a series of tweets discussing a rally in Pennsylvania where Donald Trump is speaking. The crowd is reportedly chanting "FOUR MORE YEARS," and Trump responds humorously about time in "Trump time." Various users comment on his remarks, including mocking Democrats and discussing oil prices. The tweets express enthusiasm for Trump's performance, with one user describing him as being "in his element." Overall, the sentiment is supportive of Trump's rally presence.
